平均（へいきん）

'Average' — a bare column heading with no value of its own, standing to the RIGHT of (therefore read before) the two tax columns and marking the 正稅 and 雜稅 figures as averaged annual yields rather than one year's receipts. On the facing recto (p. 92) the equivalent heading over Sakurai domain's tax block is spelled out as 五ヶ年平均 (five-year average); here it is abbreviated to 平均 alone and no year-span is printed, so the averaging window is not stated on this page.

正税（しょうぜい）　米二万九千九十九石六斗三升三合

Regular land tax, paid in rice: 29,099.633 koku, averaged (see the 平均 heading to the right). Against the 合高 of 59,028.3232 koku printed on the facing recto this is a headline rate of about 49%. IMPORTANT: the page prints 正稅 — at 8x the second label glyph is 禾+兌 (丷 over 口 over 儿), the very same glyph MASTER transcribes as 稅 in the adjacent 雜稅 row. MASTER records this field as 正租; the scan does not support that reading.

Miscellaneous taxes, in rice: 3,686.4111 koku. The sub-koku units descend strictly 石 > 斗(.1) > 升(.01) > 合(.001) > 勺(.0001) with none skipped or out of order, confirming the reading. Added to the 正稅 of 29,099.633 koku, the domain's averaged annual rice tax take is 32,786.0441 koku.

MASTER transcribes the final digit as 貳; the page prints the plain 二 (the value 552 is unaffected).

Sotsu households: 851. The sotsu were the lower/ashigaru-grade retainer stratum, ranked below shizoku in the 1869 status settlement and abolished as a category in 1872. Note the counter here is 戸, where the shizoku and heimin household columns use 軒.

Sotsu population: 2,393 persons across the 851 households to the right — about 2.8 per house, notably smaller than the shizoku figure of 4.0. The 内 introduces the split boxed below: 男千三百十八人 / 女千七十五人 = 1,318 + 1,075 = 2,393. MASTER has this split's male and female values CROSSED (see the two boxes below).

Sotsu males: 1,318 — the RIGHT-hand run of the 内 split, as 男 always is in HI. MASTER records 男千七拾八人 (1,078) here, which is wrong. Because MASTER's pair also sums to 2,393, arithmetic alone cannot adjudicate; glyph counts do. This run measurably holds 7 glyphs (男千三百十八人), whereas MASTER's 1,078 would need only 6 — so its value cannot sit in this run. Read at 5x: 千 has the slanted top stroke, 十 is a plain cross, and the last two glyphs are 八 (strokes separate and splayed) then 人 (strokes touching at the apex).

Commoner population: 58,748 persons across 12,459 households — about 4.7 per house. This is the bulk of the domain: with 華族 8, 士族 2,212 and 卒 2,393 the page totals 63,361 people. The 内 introduces the split boxed below: 男貳萬九千三十三人 / 女貳萬九千七百十五人 = 29,033 + 29,715 = 58,748. MASTER has this split's male and female values CROSSED (see the two boxes below).

Shinto shrines: 274, counted with the counter 社. Roughly three shrines per village across the domain's 93 villages. The vermilion note at the head of the page supplies the associated shrine-priest households (社家 17 戸).

寺院　百九拾ヶ寺
寺院（じいん）　百九十ヶ寺

Buddhist temples: 190, counted with the counter ヶ寺. This is the leftmost — and therefore last-read — data column on this page, but it is not the end of Kishiwada's fascicle-6 entry. The block runs on to the next leaf (printed p. 94), where 穢多 貳千百八人 (2,108 persons) and 非人 貳百四拾壹人 (241 persons), each with its own 内 男/女 split, print to the RIGHT of the ○菊間藩 marker and therefore still belong to Kishiwada. Kikuma domain's own entry begins to the LEFT of that marker. Kishiwada's entry thus spans three pages: 92 (marker and 高/外新田高/合高), 93 (this page), and the 穢多/非人 tail on 94.

An editorial note in five small-type columns, read right to left, set high above the table body. （原朱）marks the passage as written in vermilion ink in the manuscript original — an interpolation, not a printed table field, which is why it is boxed as a note rather than as data. It records the domain's Shinto shrine-priest households: 社家 17 households, 50 persons, of whom 35 male; the female count (15 by subtraction) is not printed. The final item is indented one glyph below the first two and wraps across the last two columns (男子三十 | 五人). These counts are not among MASTER's twelve rows for this page.

Running header: 'Han Institutions Overview Table, Fascicle 6 (Kishiwada)'. 第六 is the FASCICLE number of the nine-fascicle 1869–70 Dajōkan survey — a provenance pointer, not a data theme. The header's parenthetical domain name can disagree with the data on a page, but here it agrees: this verso carries Kishiwada only. The page prints the kyūjitai 覽 (MASTER normalises to 覧).
